name: Man

queries.query: Man Cote d'Ivoire official cadastral parcel map cadastre land registry GIS
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Côte d'Ivoire's SIGFU urban-land system, the Ministry of Urban Planning, Housing and Living Environment, the DGI Cadastre service, and the IDUFCI unique land identifier service. No Man-specific public parcel geometry endpoint was exposed in the bounded inspection.

queries.query: Man Côte d'Ivoire cadastre carte parcellaire registre foncier site officiel
queries.result: La recherche de première partie a identifié le SIGFU, système intégré de gestion du foncier urbain du ministère, la Direction du Cadastre de la DGI et l'IDUFCI. Le portail SIGFU décrit un service de recherche de lotissements et de lots avec cartographie, mais aucune réponse publique limitée contenant un identifiant de parcelle et une géométrie pour Man n'a pu être obtenue.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: No Man-specific municipal or departmental cadastral custodian was evidenced. The national Ministry of Urban Planning, Housing and Living Environment (MULCV/MCLU) is the evidenced urban-land custodian; DGI's Direction du Cadastre is the evidenced cadastral institution.
officialSourceAssessment.nationalUrbanLandService: SIGFU at https://sigfu.gouv.ci/public; its first-party page advertises parcel/lotissement search and cartography, and identifies the ministry contact and Guichet Unique du Foncier.
officialSourceAssessment.cadastreService: DGI Direction du Cadastre at https://dgi.gouv.ci/SITE_CADASTRE/; the page is an informational presentation and tax-notice contact page, not an exposed parcel geometry service.
officialSourceAssessment.uniqueParcelIdentifierService: IDUFCI at https://www.idufci.gouv.ci/index.html; first-party search evidence describes a unique identifier for Côte d'Ivoire land parcels, but bounded TLS-valid retrieval was unavailable.
officialSourceAssessment.registryBasis: First-party national urban-land/cadastre services explicitly expose parcel-related functions and institutional ownership. This supports registryFound=true for source discovery only, not adapter qualification or citywide geometry coverage.
officialSourceAssessment.registryFoundReason: SIGFU's official public page explicitly advertises parcel and lotissement cartographic search, while official ministry/DGI pages establish the responsible land and cadastral institutions. No Man parcel was admitted from this evidence.

schemaAndCrs.inspectionNote: The SIGFU HTML/service configuration could not be inspected because the host certificate was rejected by default TLS validation; no certificate exception was authorized. The ministry site returned HTTP 403. DGI returned HTTP 200 but its page exposed only an informational Cadastre presentation and no public map/API geometry response. IDUFCI was likewise not retrieved because its certificate was rejected. No safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was obtained.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not executed against a qualified parcel endpoint; the exact WUP point was preserved and not shifted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Côte d'Ivoire national urban-land and cadastral institutional services, with SIGFU advertising parcel/lotissement cartography.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Official service identity and national institutional scope only; no parcel geometry, map extent, Man-specific service response, or citywide coverage.
